issue.problem: Network cabinet detached from wall mount
issue.severity_reason: The cabinet is leaning dangerously and pulling on cables, posing an immediate risk of equipment damage, electrical hazard, or physical injury.
user_reported_facts: Network cabinet has torn off its wall mount
Cabinet is leaning at a steep angle
Server cables are tangled and pulling tight
Located in the 2nd floor IT closet
inferred_information: Potential for cable disconnection or port damage due to tension (uncertainty: extent of internal damage)
